company.name: Navan
company.shortDescription: Navan provides travel, expense, and corporate card management to automate manual processes and drive spend visibility.
company.description: Navan provides travel, expense, and corporate card management to automate manual processes and drive spend visibility. With one of the first enterprise technologies combining the cloud, mobile, and AI to balance business requirements with current standards, the company is reinventing the legacy category of travel and expense.

productsAndServices.description: A business travel management platform for searching, booking, and managing flights, hotels, rail, and rental cars within company policies and budgets.
productsAndServices.name: Navan Travel

productsAndServices.description: An expense management platform that automates transaction capture, categorization, reporting, approvals, reimbursements, and reconciliation.
productsAndServices.name: Navan Expense

productsAndServices.description: A corporate payments solution supporting Navan-issued cards, linked existing corporate cards, virtual cards, and reimbursements for employee out-of-pocket spending.
productsAndServices.name: Navan Payments

productsAndServices.description: An event management service for sourcing venues and coordinating company meetings, offsites, and other business events end to end.
productsAndServices.name: Navan Events

productsAndServices.description: A travel and expense analytics capability that provides interactive dashboards, spend analysis, trend exploration, alerts, and real-time program visibility.
productsAndServices.name: Navan Advanced Analytics

productsAndServices.description: An AI travel assistant for managing flights, hotels, and restaurants, with access to human travel support through chat.
productsAndServices.name: Navan Edge

items.description: Navan and Engine announced a strategic technology partnership integrating Engine’s lodging, infrastructure, and payment capabilities into Navan’s business travel platform. Initial capabilities are scheduled to roll out in September 2026, with additional group-booking and self-service features planned for subsequent months.

sources.title: Navan And Engine Announce Strategic Technology Partnership To Power New Capabilities In Business Travel

items.description: Evotec has selected Navan as its global travel and expense management platform, establishing a new commercial partnership for corporate travel and T&E services.

sources.title: Navan Selected by Evotec for Global Travel, Expense Management

items.description: Navan and Google Cloud launched a collaboration that embeds Navan’s AI travel agents into Gemini Enterprise via Google Cloud Marketplace, allowing users to plan, book, and manage travel directly inside Gemini’s interface as part of the new Navan Anywhere strategy.

sources.title: Navan Unveils 'Navan Anywhere' to Let Users Book Travel Across Platforms via AI Agents, Starting with Gemini Enterprise

items.description: Navan and Schindler Group entered into a new partnership under which Navan will provide its travel and expense management platform to modernize and unify Schindler's global travel operations across North America and Europe.

sources.title: Schindler Selects Navan to Elevate Global Travel Operations

items.description: Navan has been selected by PCL as its global travel and expense management partner, indicating a new commercial collaboration to transform PCL's travel and expense operations.

Navan announced a new strategic partnership with global consultancy Simon-Kucher, which will use Navan's AI-powered travel and expense platform to manage its global travel program across more than a dozen markets.

sources.title: Simon-Kucher Selects Navan to Modernize Global Travel Program

items.description: Navan has formed a new strategic NDC integration partnership with Emirates, creating a direct connection that delivers Emirates fares and services to Navan’s corporate travel platform users.

sources.title: Navan Accelerates NDC Adoption with New Emirates Partnership

items.description: Navan announced a new strategic partnership with Frasers Group, which selected Navan as its global travel and expense management platform to centralize bookings, payments, and expense reconciliation and improve visibility and savings.

sources.title: Frasers Group Selects Navan to Elevate Global Travel and Expense Management

items.description: Navan announced a new partnership with American Express, integrating virtual Card functionality for U.S. Business and Corporate Card Members on the Navan Travel platform. This collaboration aims to enhance expense management, security, and user experience for business travel.

Navan announced new partnerships over the past year, including a joint offering with Brex for streamlined travel payments, a collaboration with Citizens to offer travel management to bank clients, and a unified finance suite with Rho for corporate travel and expense management.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,000,000,000 to $9,200,000,000, a 1.84x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 91 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 80 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
